title: Herb Omelet with Fried Tomatoes
summary: Prepare an egg mixture with chopped cilantro and black pepper, halve a tomato, fry the tomato halves cut-side down in a non-stick pan, then cook the egg mixture into a soft omelette and serve it on a plate with the tomatoes.
source: CaptainCook4D recipe text + task graph (Herb Omelet with Fried Tomatoes); mistake hints from train split

nodes.name: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick frying pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Put the non-stick frying pan on the stove, measure one tablespoon of oil into it, and turn on the heat.
substeps: Place the non-stick frying pan on the burner
Measure one tablespoon of oil away from the pan
Pour the oil into the pan and turn on the heat
Wait until the oil shimmers
nodes.end_state: A thin film of oil coats the base of the non-stick pan on the burner and the burner is on.
nodes.view_hint: the frying pan on the stove from above

checks.question: Is a flat non-stick frying pan on the burner with a thin layer of oil?
Was the oil measured with a tablespoon?
Is the burner turned on?

mistakes.description: Pan heated before the egg mixture was beaten
mistakes.visual_cue: Oil heating in the pan while the bowl still shows unbeaten egg or missing ingredients
mistakes.correction: Turn the heat off for now and finish beating the egg mixture before heating the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Pan placed on the stove with the egg bowl still unmixed

mistakes.description: A wok used instead of a flat non-stick frying pan
mistakes.visual_cue: Deep round-bottomed wok on the burner
mistakes.correction: Use the flat non-stick frying pan, not the wok, so the omelette cooks evenly.
mistakes.early_cue: Wok lifted from the rack

mistakes.description: Too much oil, poured straight from the bottle or added extra after spilling
mistakes.visual_cue: Oil pooling deep in the pan rather than a thin coat
mistakes.correction: That is more than a tablespoon; pour the excess out so only a thin film remains.
mistakes.early_cue: Bottle tilted directly over the pan without a spoon

mistakes.description: Oil spilled onto the pan while measuring over it
mistakes.visual_cue: Oil splashes around the spoon landing in the pan
mistakes.correction: Measure the oil over the counter, not over the pan, so you don't add extra by accident.
mistakes.early_cue: Measuring spoon held over the pan while pouring from the bottle

nodes.name: Put tomatoes on a serving plate
nodes.instruction_novice: Gently set both tomato halves onto the serving plate, leaving room for the omelette.
substeps: Hold the plate near the pan
Slide each tomato half off the spatula onto the plate
Push them to one side to leave space
nodes.end_state: Two cooked tomato halves rest on one side of the serving plate with empty space beside them.

checks.question: Are two cooked tomato halves on the serving plate?
Is there clear space on the plate for the omelette?

mistakes.description: Tomatoes tipped or poured off the pan onto the plate instead of placed
mistakes.visual_cue: Pan tilted over the plate, tomatoes and oil sliding out together
mistakes.correction: Place the tomatoes with the spatula rather than tipping the pan, so the oil stays in the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Pan lifted off the burner and tilted toward the plate

mistakes.description: Tomatoes plated before the egg mixture is ready
mistakes.visual_cue: Tomatoes on the plate while the bowl shows unbeaten egg
mistakes.correction: Beat the egg mixture quickly now so you can pour it in while the pan is hot.
mistakes.early_cue: Bowl with whole yolk still on the counter

mistakes.description: Tomatoes put on the cutting board rather than the serving plate
mistakes.visual_cue: Tomato halves on the board, plate still empty
mistakes.correction: Move the tomatoes onto the serving plate.
mistakes.early_cue: Plate left in the cupboard

nodes.name: Chop 2 tbsp cilantro
nodes.instruction_novice: Take the fresh cilantro and chop it finely with a knife on the cutting board. Measure out two tablespoons of the chopped leaves.
substeps: Place the cilantro on the cutting board
Chop finely with a knife
Scoop chopped cilantro into a tablespoon, level it, and repeat for a second tablespoon
nodes.end_state: A small pile of finely chopped cilantro sits on the cutting board or in a measuring spoon, roughly two level tablespoons.
nodes.view_hint: the cutting board and measuring spoon from above

checks.question: Is the cilantro chopped into small pieces with a knife?
Was a tablespoon measure used to portion the cilantro?

mistakes.description: Cilantro portioned by eye without a measuring spoon
mistakes.visual_cue: Chopped cilantro moved straight from the board into the bowl, no measuring spoon in view
mistakes.correction: Grab a tablespoon and measure two level spoonfuls of cilantro before adding it.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaching toward the bowl with chopped cilantro and no spoon on the counter

mistakes.description: Only one tablespoon of cilantro measured instead of two
mistakes.visual_cue: A single level spoonful of cilantro set aside, no second spoonful
mistakes.correction: That is only one tablespoon, measure one more so you have two.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon put down after a single scoop

mistakes.description: Cilantro torn by hand instead of chopped with a knife
mistakes.visual_cue: Fingers tearing leaves, no knife on the board
mistakes.correction: Use the knife to chop the cilantro finely instead of tearing it by hand.
mistakes.early_cue: Cilantro picked up with both hands while the knife stays in the drawer

mistakes.description: Cilantro chopped after the pan is already heating
mistakes.visual_cue: Pan with oil shimmering on the stove while cilantro is still being chopped
mistakes.correction: Finish the egg mixture before heating the pan; turn the heat off for now and chop the cilantro.
mistakes.early_cue: Oil bottle picked up before the cilantro has been chopped

nodes.name: Stir gently with a wooden spoon so set egg moves and uncooked egg flows in
nodes.instruction_novice: Use a wooden spoon to gently push the set egg from the base toward the centre so the runny egg flows into the gaps. Keep the movements slow and small.
substeps: Pick up the wooden spoon
Drag the set egg from the edge toward the middle
Tilt the pan so the runny egg fills the space
Repeat around the pan
nodes.end_state: Soft folds of set egg sit in the pan with runny egg filling the gaps, and a wooden spoon is in hand.
nodes.view_hint: the frying pan from above, including the spoon

checks.question: Is a wooden spoon being used to stir?
Is the set egg being moved gently so runny egg fills the base?

mistakes.description: Metal spoon or metal spatula used instead of a wooden spoon
mistakes.visual_cue: Shiny metal utensil touching the non-stick pan
mistakes.correction: Swap to the wooden spoon so you don't scratch the non-stick pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Metal utensil picked up from the drawer

mistakes.description: Egg stirred too hard or pushed to the sides, breaking it into scramble
mistakes.visual_cue: Uncooked egg smeared up the pan walls or small broken curds
mistakes.correction: Stir more gently and keep the egg flat on the base; just nudge the set parts so runny egg fills in.
mistakes.early_cue: Rapid large stirring motions

mistakes.description: Heat too high so the egg sets before it can be stirred
mistakes.visual_cue: Egg browning and fully set almost immediately after pouring
mistakes.correction: Turn the heat down a bit so the egg sets slowly enough to stir.
mistakes.early_cue: Large flame or high burner setting under the pan

mistakes.description: Not stirring at all, egg cooks unevenly
mistakes.visual_cue: Spoon not touching the egg, thick runny centre with set edges
mistakes.correction: Gently push the set edges in so the runny egg can reach the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Wooden spoon left on the counter after pouring

nodes.name: Crack one egg in a bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Take one egg, tap it on the edge of the bowl, and open it so the egg drops into the bowl. Check there is no shell in the bowl.
substeps: Pick up one egg
Tap it firmly on the rim of the bowl
Open the shell over the bowl and let the egg fall in
Pick out any shell fragments
nodes.end_state: One egg yolk and white sit in the bowl with no shell pieces, and the empty shell is set aside.
nodes.view_hint: inside the mixing bowl from above

checks.question: Is there one cracked egg in the bowl?
Is the bowl free of shell fragments?

mistakes.description: Egg cracked after the tomatoes are already cooking
mistakes.visual_cue: Tomato halves sizzling in the pan while an egg is being cracked into a bowl
mistakes.correction: The egg mixture should be ready before the tomatoes cook; finish the bowl quickly and keep an eye on the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Pan heating with tomatoes while the egg carton is still unopened

mistakes.description: Shell pieces fall into the bowl
mistakes.visual_cue: White shell fragments visible in the egg
mistakes.correction: There is some shell in the bowl, scoop it out with a spoon or a piece of shell.
mistakes.early_cue: Egg crushed instead of cleanly cracked

mistakes.description: More than one egg cracked into the bowl
mistakes.visual_cue: Two yolks in the bowl
mistakes.correction: The recipe uses one egg, remove the extra or set it aside.
mistakes.early_cue: A second egg picked up after the first is in the bowl

nodes.name: Cook the tomatoes cut-side down until they start to soften and colour
nodes.instruction_novice: Place the two tomato halves in the hot pan with the cut side facing down. Let them cook until they soften and the cut side turns golden.
substeps: Put both halves in the pan cut side down
Leave them without moving
Watch for the edges to soften and the cut face to brown
nodes.end_state: Two tomato halves sit cut-side down in the pan with softened edges and browned cut faces.
nodes.view_hint: the frying pan from above, close on the tomatoes

checks.question: Are both tomato halves in the pan with the cut face down and the rounded skin up?
Do the tomatoes look softened with browned cut edges?

mistakes.description: Tomatoes taken out before they soften and colour
mistakes.visual_cue: Firm tomato halves with pale cut faces being lifted after a short time
mistakes.correction: They aren't ready yet; leave them cut-side down until they soften and the cut side browns.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon reaching for the tomatoes seconds after they went in

mistakes.description: Tomatoes placed skin-side down
mistakes.visual_cue: Red cut faces pointing up in the pan
mistakes.correction: Flip the tomatoes so the cut side is down against the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Tomato half lowered with the cut face up

mistakes.description: Tomatoes cooked before the egg mixture is ready
mistakes.visual_cue: Tomatoes in the pan while the bowl still holds unbeaten egg
mistakes.correction: Finish beating the egg mixture now so it's ready as soon as the tomatoes are done.
mistakes.early_cue: Tomato halves carried to the stove with the egg bowl still unmixed

nodes.name: Pour the egg mixture into the pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Pour the beaten egg mixture from the bowl into the hot pan so it spreads over the base.
substeps: Pick up the bowl of beaten egg
Pour it into the centre of the pan
Tilt the pan slightly so it covers the base
nodes.end_state: A thin layer of yellow egg with green flecks covers the base of the pan and the bowl is empty.

checks.question: Does the egg mixture cover the base of the pan?
Is the bowl empty?

mistakes.description: Egg poured in while the tomatoes are still in the pan
mistakes.visual_cue: Tomato halves sitting in the egg in the pan
mistakes.correction: Take the tomatoes out onto the plate before pouring in the egg.
mistakes.early_cue: Bowl lifted toward the pan with tomatoes still inside

mistakes.description: Some of the mixture left in the bowl
mistakes.visual_cue: Egg still clinging in the bowl after pouring
mistakes.correction: Scrape the rest of the egg from the bowl into the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Bowl set down quickly after a short pour

mistakes.description: Egg poured into a pan with no oil or a cold pan
mistakes.visual_cue: Egg sits still with no sizzle and no sheen of oil
mistakes.correction: The pan should be hot with oil before the egg goes in; make sure the heat is on.
mistakes.early_cue: Burner knob in the off position

nodes.name: Add the chopped cilantro to the bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Scrape the two tablespoons of chopped cilantro into the bowl with the egg.
substeps: Scoop the measured cilantro with the spoon or knife
Tip it into the bowl
Scrape any leftover bits from the board
nodes.end_state: Green chopped cilantro floats on the egg in the bowl and the board is clear of cilantro.
nodes.view_hint: inside the mixing bowl from above

checks.question: Is chopped cilantro visible in the bowl with the egg?
Has all the measured cilantro left the cutting board?

mistakes.description: Cilantro added after the tomatoes have been cooked
mistakes.visual_cue: Cooked tomatoes on the plate or in the pan while cilantro goes into the bowl
mistakes.correction: The cilantro should go in before cooking the tomatoes; add it now and beat the mixture right away.
mistakes.early_cue: Tomatoes placed in the pan while cilantro remains on the board

mistakes.description: Cilantro added to the pan instead of the bowl
mistakes.visual_cue: Green leaves landing in the frying pan
mistakes.correction: The cilantro goes into the egg bowl, not the pan.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand with cilantro moving toward the stove

mistakes.description: Only part of the cilantro added
mistakes.visual_cue: Pile of chopped cilantro still on the board after adding
mistakes.correction: There is still cilantro on the board, scrape the rest into the bowl.
mistakes.early_cue: Board set aside with green bits still on it

nodes.name: Transfer omelette to the plate and serve with the tomatoes
nodes.instruction_novice: Slide the omelette out of the pan onto the serving plate next to the tomatoes. It is ready to serve.
substeps: Loosen the omelette edges with the wooden spoon
Tilt the pan over the plate
Slide or fold the omelette onto the plate beside the tomatoes
nodes.end_state: The omelette and the two tomato halves sit together on the serving plate and the pan is empty.

checks.question: Is the whole omelette on the serving plate?
Are the tomato halves on the same plate as the omelette?
Is the pan empty?

mistakes.description: Omelette placed on the cutting board or a different plate from the tomatoes
mistakes.visual_cue: Omelette on a board or second plate, tomatoes on another
mistakes.correction: Put the omelette on the same plate as the tomatoes so they are served together.
mistakes.early_cue: Pan tilted toward the cutting board

mistakes.description: Omelette breaks apart during transfer
mistakes.visual_cue: Omelette in several torn pieces on the plate
mistakes.correction: Loosen the edges first and slide it out slowly in one piece.
mistakes.early_cue: Omelette lifted from the middle with the spoon

mistakes.description: Part of the omelette left stuck in the pan
mistakes.visual_cue: Pieces of egg remaining on the pan base after plating
mistakes.correction: Scrape the rest of the omelette onto the plate.
mistakes.early_cue: Pan set back on the stove with egg still inside

nodes.name: Scoop the tomatoes from the pan
nodes.instruction_novice: Use a spoon or spatula to lift both tomato halves out of the pan, keeping the pan on the heat.
substeps: Slide the spatula under one tomato half
Lift it out
Repeat for the second half
nodes.end_state: The pan is empty except for oil, and both tomato halves are held on the spatula or already on the serving plate.
nodes.view_hint: the frying pan and the spatula

checks.question: Is the pan now free of tomatoes?
Are both tomato halves on the spatula or plate, not on the cutting board?

mistakes.description: Cooked tomatoes placed on the cutting board instead of a plate
mistakes.visual_cue: Browned tomato halves resting on the wooden cutting board
mistakes.correction: Put the cooked tomatoes on the serving plate, not back on the cutting board.
mistakes.early_cue: Spatula with tomatoes moving toward the board

mistakes.description: Tomatoes scooped out before the egg mixture is beaten and ready
mistakes.visual_cue: Tomatoes lifted out while the bowl still holds unbeaten egg
mistakes.correction: Beat the egg mixture now before pouring, so the pan isn't sitting empty on the heat.
mistakes.early_cue: Fork still unused next to a bowl with whole yolk

mistakes.description: Only one tomato half removed
mistakes.visual_cue: One tomato half still sitting in the pan
mistakes.correction: There is still a tomato in the pan, take that one out too.
mistakes.early_cue: Spatula set down after lifting a single half

nodes.name: Stop stirring when nearly cooked to let it set into an omelette
nodes.instruction_novice: When there is only a little runny egg left on top, stop stirring and let the egg set into one flat omelette.
substeps: Check the surface is mostly set with just a little gloss
Lift the spoon out and leave the egg alone
Wait a few seconds until the surface is set
nodes.end_state: One flat round omelette sits untouched in the pan with a set surface and the spoon resting away from it.

checks.question: Is the egg one continuous flat omelette rather than loose pieces?
Is the surface set with no runny egg?

mistakes.description: Stirring continued too long so the egg sets into small scrambled pieces
mistakes.visual_cue: Loose broken curds in the pan instead of one sheet
mistakes.correction: Stop stirring now and let the egg set as one piece.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon still moving when most of the egg has set

mistakes.description: Stirring stopped too early, leaving lots of runny egg
mistakes.visual_cue: Pools of liquid egg across the top with set edges
mistakes.correction: There is still runny egg; give it a few more gentle stirs before letting it set.
mistakes.early_cue: Spoon put down right after the first stir

mistakes.description: Omelette left too long and browns or burns
mistakes.visual_cue: Dark brown underside or smoke from the pan
mistakes.correction: It is done, take it off the heat before it burns.
mistakes.early_cue: Edges darkening while the pan stays on high heat

nodes.name: Cut tomato into two pieces
nodes.instruction_novice: Cut the tomato in half with the knife so you have two equal pieces.
substeps: Hold the tomato steady on the board
Cut straight down through the middle
Check you have two halves
nodes.end_state: Two tomato halves with flat cut faces sit on the cutting board.

checks.question: Are there exactly two tomato pieces on the board?
Does each piece have a single flat cut face?

mistakes.description: Tomato chopped into many small pieces instead of two halves
mistakes.visual_cue: Several small tomato chunks or dice on the board
mistakes.correction: Just cut the tomato in half, two pieces only, so they can fry cut-side down.
mistakes.early_cue: Knife making a second cut on a tomato half

mistakes.description: Tomato cut after the pan is already heating
mistakes.visual_cue: Pan on heat with oil while the tomato is being cut
mistakes.correction: Cut the tomato before heating the pan; lower the heat while you finish.
mistakes.early_cue: Oil poured into the pan with a whole tomato still on the board

nodes.name: Take a tomato
nodes.instruction_novice: Pick up one whole tomato and put it on the cutting board.
substeps: Locate the tomatoes
Pick up one whole tomato
Place it on the cutting board
nodes.end_state: One whole tomato sits on the cutting board.

checks.question: Is there a whole tomato on the cutting board?
Is the item a tomato and not another vegetable?

mistakes.description: Only half a tomato taken instead of a whole one
mistakes.visual_cue: A tomato half with a cut face on the board
mistakes.correction: You need a whole tomato so you get two halves; pick up a whole one.
mistakes.early_cue: Hand reaching for a pre-cut tomato piece

mistakes.description: Tomato taken after the pan is already heating
mistakes.visual_cue: Oil shimmering in the pan while a tomato is fetched
mistakes.correction: Get the tomato cut before the pan heats; turn the heat down while you prep it.
mistakes.early_cue: Stove knob turned before any tomato is on the board

nodes.name: Beat the contents of the bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Use a fork to beat the egg, cilantro, and pepper together until the yolk and white are fully blended.
substeps: Hold the bowl steady with one hand
Whisk quickly with a fork in circles
Stop when no streaks of white remain
nodes.end_state: The bowl holds a uniform pale yellow mixture with green cilantro flecks and no separate yolk or white.
nodes.view_hint: inside the mixing bowl from above

checks.question: Is the egg mixture uniformly yellow with no separate yolk or clear white?
Are cilantro and pepper visible mixed through the egg?

mistakes.description: Beating done after the tomatoes have already cooked
mistakes.visual_cue: Cooked tomatoes on the plate or pan while the egg is still being beaten
mistakes.correction: The egg mixture should be beaten before cooking the tomatoes; finish beating now and keep the pan on low.
mistakes.early_cue: Tomatoes placed in the pan while yolk is still whole in the bowl

mistakes.description: Mixture not beaten enough, yolk still separate
mistakes.visual_cue: Streaks of clear white and an intact yolk in the bowl
mistakes.correction: Keep beating until the yolk and white are fully blended and even in color.
mistakes.early_cue: Fork lifted out after only a couple of strokes

mistakes.description: Beating before cilantro or pepper were added
mistakes.visual_cue: Beaten egg with no green flecks or pepper specks
mistakes.correction: Add the cilantro and pepper first, then beat everything together.
mistakes.early_cue: Fork picked up while cilantro is still on the board

nodes.name: Add 1/2 tsp ground black pepper to the bowl
nodes.instruction_novice: Measure half a teaspoon of ground black pepper with a measuring spoon and tip it into the bowl with the egg.
substeps: Pick up the half-teaspoon measure
Fill it level with ground black pepper over the counter, not over the bowl
Tip the pepper into the bowl
nodes.end_state: A small sprinkle of black pepper is visible on top of the egg in the bowl.
nodes.view_hint: inside the mixing bowl and the measuring spoon

checks.question: Is black pepper visible on the egg in the bowl?
Was a measuring spoon used for the pepper?

mistakes.description: Pepper shaken directly into the bowl without measuring
mistakes.visual_cue: Pepper shaker tilted over the bowl, no measuring spoon in hand
mistakes.correction: Use the half-teaspoon measure for the pepper instead of shaking it straight in.
mistakes.early_cue: Shaker lifted toward the bowl with no spoon in view

mistakes.description: Too much pepper added because it overflowed the spoon while pouring from the shaker
mistakes.visual_cue: Heaped spoon or pepper spilling over the bowl rim
mistakes.correction: That is more than half a teaspoon; level the spoon and fill it over the counter next time.
mistakes.early_cue: Shaker poured rapidly into a small spoon held over the bowl

mistakes.description: Pepper added after the pan is already heating or tomatoes are done
mistakes.visual_cue: Pan on heat or cooked tomatoes on a plate while pepper is being added to the bowl
mistakes.correction: The egg mixture should be finished before the pan heats; add the pepper now and lower the heat.
mistakes.early_cue: Stove turned on before pepper has been added
